scenes.line1: How does C# prevent resource leaks?
scenes.say: Ever wondered how C Sharp keeps your resources safe, even when errors pop up?

scenes.label: Exceptions
scenes.sub: Exceptions handle errors and keep code robust.
scenes.say: Exceptions help you deal with errors and keep your code running smoothly.
Using statements automatically clean up resources. Manual disposal means you have to remember to call Dispose, or you risk leaks.
With modern C Sharp, using declarations make your code cleaner and ensure files or streams are released, even if an error happens.

scenes.question: What happens if you forget Dispose?
scenes.wrong: The object is cleaned up automatically.
scenes.right: You risk memory leaks or locked resources.
scenes.say: If you skip Dispose, you could leave memory or files hanging around, which can cause real headaches.
